CONTEXT: the backend now supports a story ending (already present in this worktree): the turn response and the session state carry `story_complete` (bool) and, when true, `ending_marker` (string); the ending's closing paragraph arrives as the last narration segment of the turn that completes the story; any later turn returns HTTP 200 with the marker and story_complete true, and makes no model call. Read storygame/web_demo.py and tests/test_story_ending.py (read only) to see the exact response shape before you code.

BUILD:
1. frontend/src/main.js: when a turn payload (or session state) has story_complete true, render the ending_marker as its own visually distinct entry (kind "ending") after the narration, disable the command input and send button, set the status line to the marker text, and keep New Game enabled. A new session or New Game clears the completed state. setBusy must not re-enable the input while the story is complete. Add minimal styling in styles.css for `.entry-ending` (centered, muted, letter-spaced, matching the existing theme tokens). Put any pure logic (for example deciding whether input is allowed) in a small exported function with a node test, in the same style as src/turn_rendering.js and its test.
2. frontend/e2e/blind-player.js and blind-player.spec.js: record `story_complete` on every turn record (default false when absent). When a turn completes the story, the player stops taking turns for that scene, and the scene record gets `ending_reached: true` and exit_cause `ending` (and exit_transition_cause null). Scenes that do not end keep their current fields unchanged. The analysis/report (analyseRun and the markdown/JSON writers) must include `ending_reached` per scene and a run-level `ending_reached` (true only if the last scene ended the story). merge-blind-player.js must carry the new fields through the merged report; update its test. Canonical and raw profiles behave the same. Old reports without the field must still merge and render.
3. Tests: add node tests (node --test) for: the input-allowed helper, turn record default and true cases, analysis with ending_reached true and false, merge carrying the field, old report without the field. Hermetic; no network, no Playwright run.
4. Hard rules: no story-specific text in code, no change to the ending text itself, keep existing behaviours and existing tests passing except where the contract legitimately changed (say which in notes). Plain comments matching surrounding style.

HOW TO RUN: from the worktree, check `ls frontend/node_modules`; if missing, symlink it to /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules, then `cd frontend && npm test`. Do not run Playwright. Reply with the files changed.
